43.Comments:
This expressive command will accept number buffer input and set the pilot altimeter
to the value entered into the number buffer. It will also convert hpa to inches of mercury
if the sim is in metric pressure mode.

If no data is in the number buffer, then the command will set the altimeter to standard
pressure.
43.Expression:
if[srs_number_buffer_length > 0,	// If there is something in the number buffer
	if[qnh = 1, srs_number_buffer_value * .02953, srs_number_buffer_value]	// Then use it as entered or convert it if necessary
	,		// Else no data in the number buffer
	29.92	// Set it to standard pressure
]
43.Name: PF Set Baro
